add.content: Earlier W-based RHEAs combined high melting temperature with better high-temperature strength than Ni superalloys or pure W.
add.evidence_span: W-based refractory HEAs (RHEAs) have been recently developed in the context of high-temperature applications, showing high melting temperature (above 2873 K) and superior mechanical strength at high temperatures compared to Ni-based superalloys or pure W

add.content: The preceding W-Ta-Cr-V alloy resisted loops and helium bubbles better than earlier W alloys.
add.evidence_span: Its response to loop formation under ion irradiation [22] and He implantation [23] is enhanced compared to previously developed W-based alloys, showing no noticeable dislocation loop formation and smaller He bubbles with no radiation-induced segregation at grain boundaries upon heavy ion irradiation and He implantation, respectively.

add.content: Dual-beam irradiation reverses annealing-driven grain growth and refines the grains.
add.evidence_span: After He implantation, the grain size further increased to 36.3 ± 1.8 nm. However, during the dual-beam irradiation, grain refinement occurred, and the average grain size dropped to 21.1 ± 1.4 nm

add.content: Hf segregation to grain boundaries accounts for annealing hardening.
add.evidence_span: The increase in hardness after annealing was ~3 GPa and this can be directly attributed to Hf segregation to grain boundaries

add.content: Inverse Kirkendall transport or ballistic mixing depletes Hf from irradiated grain boundaries.
add.evidence_span: The EDX demonstrated depletion of Hf from grain boundaries during irradiation which can be attributed to the Inverse Kirkendall effect (IKE) [36] and/or ballistic mixing during irradiation [37]

add.content: Irradiation homogenized the elements and produced no precipitates.
add.evidence_span: The irradiated part showed homogenization of the elements and no precipitation.

add.content: The rough helium energy landscape favors rapid trapping at stable bubble nuclei.
add.evidence_span: This rough energy landscape implies that He has a higher tendency to quickly find a fairly stable site that can act as a bubble nuclei

add.content: Near the Hall-Petch crossover, small grain refinement can cause a large hardness increase.
add.evidence_span: This change is higher when the grain size is very small and approaches the edge of the transition from the Hall-Petch to the Inverse Hall-Petch effect

add.content: CALPHAD predicts a single BCC phase over a wide temperature range.
add.evidence_span: which are predicted by CALPHAD to form a single-phase BCC structure over a wide temperature range

add.content: Irradiation cavities reached a saturation regime after initial formation.
add.evidence_span: No increasing trends in cavity volume, density, or change in volume occur after that, and saturation is evident for these dpa/He percentage ranges.
